paras: Cyrtodactylus hikidai  is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to the island of Natuna Besar in Indonesia.
The specific name, hikidai, is in honor of Japanese herpetologist Tsutomu Hikida.
Large for its genus, C. hikidai may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 10.2 cm (4.0 in).
